Job description

Launch Your Career with Next Education!


Walk-In Drive | Backend Java Developer Intern (Unpaid Internship)

Are you passionate about coding and problem-solving?


Next Education is looking for high-potential freshers with a strong foundation in Java, Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA), and logical problem-solving to join our Backend Java Development Internship Program.


This internship offers an opportunity to work on real-world projects, learn from experienced professionals, and build a strong foundation for a career in software development.


Position Details


  • Role: Backend Java Developer Intern
  • Duration: 3 Months (Unpaid)
  • Location: Banjara Hills, Hyderabad
  • Work Mode: Work From Office

Who Can Apply?


Freshers and 2025/2026 graduates from:

  • B.E./B.Tech CSE, IT, AI/ML, Data Science, ECE
  • BCA / MCA
  • B.Sc./M.Sc. (Computer Science / IT)

Preferred Candidate Profile


We are looking for candidates with:


  • Strong knowledge of Core Java & OOPs
  • Good understanding of Data Structures & Algorithms
  • Knowledge of Arrays, Strings, Hashing, Sorting & Recursion
  • Basic understanding of Dynamic Programming and SQL
  • Excellent analytical, logical reasoning, and problem-solving skills

Selection Process


Round 1: Technical Coding Assessment (DSA & Programming), Aptitude test


Topics include:


  • Data Structures & Algorithms
  • Problem Solving
  • Java Programming Fundamentals
  • Logical Reasoning
  • Time & Space Complexity

Round 2: Technical Interview (Java, OOPs, SQL & Coding)


Final Round: HR Interaction & Internship Offer


Walk-In Details


Date: 7th July to 9th July 2026

Day : Wednesday to Friday

Time: 3:00 PM


Venue:
Next Education India Pvt. Ltd.
Sri Nilaya Cyber Spazio, 3rd Floor, East Wing
Road No. 2, Near Annapurna Studios
Banjara Hills, Hyderabad 500034


Documents to Carry


  • Updated Resume
  • Government Photo ID
  • Academic Certificates/Mark Sheets

Important: This opportunity is intended for candidates with a strong coding and DSA foundation. Candidates who have previously appeared for the Backend Java Developer recruitment process with Next Education are not eligible to attend this walk-in.
